script.title: A Better Way to Care — Welbuk

ananya.name: Dr. Ananya
ananya.description: Indian woman in her late 30s, clinic owner and doctor. Calm, confident and caring. Teal kurta beneath an open white coat (source). Shoulder-length black hair tied in a low bun with a few loose strands, slim build, small gold stud earrings, a stethoscope worn around her neck (never in use) in every scene where she wears the white coat (manga supplement, from the accepted reference sheet).

traits: Calm almond-shaped eyes with slightly heavy upper lids and a gentle downward outer corner
Soft, straight medium-thick eyebrows set fairly level
Oval face with a defined, slightly pointed chin and a small bindi-free forehead; small nose with a rounded tip
faceDesign.settingBasis: Source: Indian female clinic owner, late 30s, calm, confident, caring; teal kurta beneath white coat. Manga supplement: the three face traits, low bun hairstyle and gold studs, chosen to separate her from Meera.

meera.name: Meera
meera.description: Indian woman in her late 20s, clinic receptionist. Friendly and capable. Blue kurta (source). Long black hair in a single side braid over her left shoulder, round face, slim build, a thin silver bangle on the right wrist (manga supplement).

traits: Large, round bright eyes with clearly visible lower lash line
Thin, gently arched eyebrows set high above the eyes
Round face with full cheeks and a short soft chin; small dimple on the left cheek when smiling
faceDesign.settingBasis: Source: Indian female receptionist, late 20s, friendly and capable, blue kurta. Manga supplement: the three face traits, side braid and silver bangle.

ravi.name: Ravi
ravi.description: Indian man in his mid-30s, patient. Warm and approachable. Light green shirt (source). Short neat black hair with a side part, trimmed short beard, medium build, dark trousers, a simple wristwatch on the left wrist, small dark-brown shoulder bag (manga supplement).

traits: Warm, slightly narrow eyes that crease at the outer corners when he smiles
Thick, straight dark eyebrows close to the eyes
Square jaw framed by a short trimmed beard and a broad nose
faceDesign.settingBasis: Source: Indian male patient, mid-30s, warm, approachable, light green shirt. Manga supplement: the three face traits, beard, side part and wristwatch.

specialist.name: Specialist (vision)
specialist.description: Symbolic specialist doctor in a future-vision clinic in another city. Indian man in his 50s with greying temples, rimless glasses, light grey blazer over a pale blue shirt, stethoscope around his neck (manga supplement; the source only says "specialist").

traits: Kind eyes behind thin rimless rectangular glasses
Bushy salt-and-pepper eyebrows
Long face with deep smile lines and a neat grey moustache
faceDesign.settingBasis: Source: "a conceptual Welbuk-connected clinic and specialist". Every visual detail is a manga supplement.

Medium eyebrows with a high gentle arch

traits: Large round eyes behind thin round glasses
Thin straight eyebrows
Narrow face with a sharp chin and light freckles across the nose
faceDesign.settingBasis: Revised source (2026-11-12): the lab is notified of the samples and Ravi gives his samples at the clinic lab. Appearance is a manga supplement.

script.style: Full-colour, approachable Indian slice-of-life manga. Clean confident line art with varied line weight, soft flat cel shading, warm natural daylight, restrained blue and teal accents, simple readable backgrounds. Expressive but natural faces, precise hands. No photorealism, no glossy gradients, no surface microtexture. Absolutely no text, letters, logos, numbers, speech bubbles or captions inside the artwork; device screens show only abstract blank blocks and simple icons.
script.continuity: Keep Dr. Ananya, Meera, Ravi, the Nurse, Mr. Raman, Priya, the Pharmacist and the Lab Technician identical to their canonical reference sheets in face traits, hair, build, skin tone and clothing for the whole comic. Device screens never show readable text or real personal data. Page 9 panels 2-3 (09-2, 09-3) are a future vision: soft pale-blue vignette border and lighter, airy palette so they never read as current features.

clinic-morning.summary: A weekday morning at Dr. Ananya’s friendly neighbourhood clinic in Tamil Nadu, before Welbuk: busy reception, paper registers, ringing phone, queue.
clinic-morning.location: Small neighbourhood clinic in Tamil Nadu: whitewashed entrance with potted plants and a simple awning, reception desk with paper registers and a desk phone, waiting chairs (setting is source; furniture details are manga supplement).

onboarding.summary: Later the same week, after hours: the clinic sets up Welbuk. Ananya configures Welbuk Practice on a laptop; Meera tries Welbuk Care on a staff phone.
